eventDetail.eventTitle: 2026 International Conference on AI-Driven Sustainable Cyber-Physical Systems (AISCPS)
eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Computing and Processing; Engineered Materials, Dielectrics and Plasmas; Power, Energy and Industry Applications; Robotics and Control Systems; Signal Processing and Analysis
eventDetail.sponsors: Guru Nanak Institute of Technology; JIS Group; Kolkata Section
eventDetail.scope: The conference focuses on the integration of AI, machine learning, data analytics, sensing, communication, control, and computing technologies with physical systems to develop intelligent, adaptive, secure, and energy-efficient solutions for next-generation applications. AISCPS emphasizes sustainable development goals (SDGs) by addressing energy efficiency, environmental impact, safety, reliability, and human-centric design across cyber-physical infrastructures.
